006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.ArithmeticFunctionException;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.CastFunctionException;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.InvalidValueForCastFunctionException;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.impl.OperationFunctions;
012import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IAtomicOrUnionType;
013import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.InvalidTypeMetapathException;
014import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.impl.TypeConstants;
015import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
016
017import java.math.BigDecimal;
018import java.math.BigInteger;
019import java.math.MathContext;
020import java.math.RoundingMode;
021
022import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
023
024/**
025 * Represents an atomic Metapath item containing a numeric data value, which can
026 * be either an integer or decimal. This interface provides operations for
027 * numeric type conversion, comparison, and mathematical operations commonly
028 * used in Metapath expressions.
029 *
030 * @see IIntegerItem
031 * @see IDecimalItem
032 */
033public interface INumericItem extends IAnyAtomicItem {
034  /**
035   * Get the type information for this item.
036   *
037   * @return the type information
038   */
039  @NonNull
040  static IAtomicOrUnionType<INumericItem> type() {
041    return TypeConstants.NUMERIC_TYPE;
042  }
043
044  /**
045   * Cast the provided type to this item type.
046   *
047   * @param item
048   *          the item to cast
049   * @return the original item if it is already this type, otherwise a new item
050   *         cast to this type
051   * @throws InvalidValueForCastFunctionException
052   *           if the provided {@code item} cannot be cast to this type
053   */
054  @NonNull
055  static INumericItem cast(@NonNull IAnyAtomicItem item) {
056    try {
057      return item instanceof INumericItem
058          ? (INumericItem) item
059          : IDecimalItem.valueOf(item.asString());
060    } catch (IllegalStateException | InvalidTypeMetapathException ex) {
061      // asString can throw IllegalStateException exception
062      throw new InvalidValueForCastFunctionException(ex);
063    }
064  }
065
066  /**
067   * Get this item's value as a decimal.
068   *
069   * @return the equivalent decimal value
070   */
071  @NonNull
072  BigDecimal asDecimal();
073
074  /**
075   * Get this item's value as an integer.
076   *
077   * @return the equivalent integer value
078   */
079  @NonNull
080  BigInteger asInteger();
081
082  /**
083   * Convert this numeric item to a Java int, exactly. If the value is not in a
084   * valid int range, an exception is thrown.
085   *
086   * @return the int value
087   * @throws CastFunctionException
088   *           if the value does not fit in an int
089   */
090  int toIntValueExact();
091
092  /**
093   * Get the effective boolean value of this item based on
094   * <a href="https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-31/#id-ebv">XPath 3.1</a>.
095   *
096   * @return the effective boolean value
097   */
098  boolean toEffectiveBoolean();
099
100  @Override
101  INumericItem castAsType(IAnyAtomicItem item);
102
103  /**
104   * Get the absolute value of the item.
105   *
106   * @return this item negated if this item is negative, or the item otherwise
107   */
108  @NonNull
109  INumericItem abs();
110
111  /**
112   * Round the value to the whole number closest to positive infinity.
113   *
114   * @return the rounded value
115   */
116  @NonNull
117  IIntegerItem ceiling();
118
119  /**
120   * Round the value to the whole number closest to negative infinity.
121   *
122   * @return the rounded value
123   */
124  @NonNull
125  IIntegerItem floor();
126
127  /**
128   * Round the item's value with zero precision.
129   * <p>
130   * This is the same as calling {@link #round(IIntegerItem)} with a precision of
131   * {@code 0}.
132   *
133   * @return the rounded value
134   */
135  @NonNull
136  default INumericItem round() {
137    return round(IIntegerItem.ZERO);
138  }
139
140  /**
141   * Round the item's value with the specified precision.
142   * <p>
143   * This is the same as calling {@link #round(IIntegerItem)} with a precision of
144   * {@code 0}.
145   *
146   * @param precisionItem
147   *          the precision indicating the number of digits to round to before
148   *          (negative value} or after (positive value) the decimal point.
149   * @return the rounded value
150   */
151  @NonNull
152  default INumericItem round(@NonNull IIntegerItem precisionItem) {
153    int precision;
154    try {
155      precision = precisionItem.toIntValueExact();
156    } catch (CastFunctionException ex) {
157      throw new ArithmeticFunctionException(ArithmeticFunctionException.OVERFLOW_UNDERFLOW_ERROR,
158          "Numeric operation overflow/underflow.", ex);
159    }
160    return precision >= 0
161        ? roundWithPositivePrecision(precision)
162        : roundWithNegativePrecision(precision);
163  }
164
165  @NonNull
166  private INumericItem roundWithPositivePrecision(int precision) {
167    INumericItem retval;
168    if (this instanceof IIntegerItem) {
169      retval = this;
170    } else {
171      BigDecimal value = asDecimal();
172      BigDecimal rounded = value.signum() == -1
173          ? value.round(new MathContext(precision + value.precision() - value.scale(), RoundingMode.HALF_DOWN))
174          : value.round(new MathContext(precision + value.precision() - value.scale(), RoundingMode.HALF_UP));
175      retval = castAsType(IDecimalItem.valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(rounded)));
176    }
177    return retval;
178  }
179
180  /**
181   * Rounds a number to the specified negative precision by: 1. Computing the
182   * divisor (10^|precision|) 2. If the absolute value is less than the divisor,
183   * returns 0 3. Otherwise, rounds to the nearest multiple of the divisor
184   *
185   * @param precision
186   *          the negative precision to round to
187   * @return the rounded value
188   */
189  @NonNull
190  private INumericItem roundWithNegativePrecision(int precision) {
191    BigInteger value = asInteger();
192    BigInteger divisor = BigInteger.TEN.pow(0 - precision);
193
194    INumericItem retval;
195    if (divisor.compareTo(value.abs()) > 0) {
196      retval = IIntegerItem.ZERO;
197    } else {
198      BigInteger remainder = value.mod(divisor);
199      BigInteger lessRemainder = value.subtract(remainder);
200      BigInteger halfDivisor = divisor.divide(BigInteger.TWO);
201      BigInteger roundedValue = remainder.compareTo(halfDivisor) >= 0
202          ? lessRemainder.add(divisor)
203          : lessRemainder;
204      retval = IIntegerItem.valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(roundedValue));
205    }
206    return retval;
207  }
208
209  /**
210   * Create a new sum by adding this value to the provided addend value.
211   *
212   * @param addend
213   *          the second value to sum
214   * @return a new value resulting from adding this value to the provided addend
215   *         value
216   */
217  @NonNull
218  default INumericItem add(@NonNull INumericItem addend) {
219    return OperationFunctions.opNumericAdd(this, addend);
220  }
221
222  /**
223   * Determine the difference by subtracting the provided subtrahend value from
224   * this minuend value.
225   *
226   * @param subtrahend
227   *          the value to subtract
228   * @return a new value resulting from subtracting the subtrahend from the
229   *         minuend
230   */
231  @NonNull
232  default INumericItem subtract(@NonNull INumericItem subtrahend) {
233    return OperationFunctions.opNumericSubtract(this, subtrahend);
234  }
235
236  /**
237   * Multiply this multiplicand value by the provided multiplier value.
238   *
239   * @param multiplier
240   *          the value to multiply by
241   * @return a new value resulting from multiplying the multiplicand by the
242   *         multiplier
243   */
244  @NonNull
245  default INumericItem multiply(@NonNull INumericItem multiplier) {
246    return OperationFunctions.opNumericMultiply(this, multiplier);
247  }
248
249  /**
250   * Divide this dividend value by the provided divisor value.
251   *
252   * @param divisor
253   *          the value to divide by
254   * @return a new value resulting from dividing the dividend by the divisor
255   */
256  @NonNull
257  default INumericItem divide(@NonNull INumericItem divisor) {
258    return OperationFunctions.opNumericDivide(this, divisor);
259  }
260
261  /**
262   * Divide this dividend value by the provided divisor value using integer
263   * division.
264   *
265   * @param divisor
266   *          the value to divide by
267   * @return a new value resulting from dividing the dividend by the divisor
268   */
269  @NonNull
270  default IIntegerItem integerDivide(@NonNull INumericItem divisor) {
271    return OperationFunctions.opNumericIntegerDivide(this, divisor);
272  }
273
274  /**
275   * Compute the remainder when dividing this dividend value by the provided
276   * divisor value.
277   *
278   * @param divisor
279   *          the value to divide by
280   * @return a new value containing the remainder resulting from dividing the
281   *         dividend by the divisor
282   */
283  @NonNull
284  default INumericItem mod(@NonNull INumericItem divisor) {
285    return OperationFunctions.opNumericMod(this, divisor);
286  }
287
288  /**
289   * Reverse the sign of this value.
290   *
291   * @return a new value with the sign reversed
292   */
293  @NonNull
294  default INumericItem negate() {
295    return OperationFunctions.opNumericUnaryMinus(this);
296  }
297}
